title: US Treasury Yields & Interest Rates Scraper

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: Which official Treasury dataset to pull. Daily yield curve is the one most people want: par yields for 1-month through 30-year maturities, one row per trading day.
enumTitles: Average interest rates on US debt

sinceDays.title: History (days)
sinceDays.description: How far back to go, in days. 0 = full available history (the yield curve goes back to 1990; other datasets vary). Rows come newest first, so Max rows caps long pulls at the recent end.

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new rows only
newOnly.description: Remember rows already returned and emit only ones not seen before. Run on a daily schedule for a clean feed of fresh yields, auctions or debt figures - quiet runs cost nothing.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows, newest first.
